steps.text: Kal'tsit enters the Sarcophagus.
She had once stood watch over this very Sarcophagus, waiting for an elusive speck of hope from the Sarcophagus's master.
Transcending the temporal constraints of civilization, this space leads to the secrets in the deepest reaches of the ship.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Sarcophagus has my profile?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Time is of the essence. I must connect to the core databanks of PRTS.

a.text: Warning: No administrator privileges. Access will be restricted.
Warning: Unable to load repair module. Adaptation incomplete—

steps.text: (Unknown language) Dear Kal'tsit. If you have triggered this encrypted AI model, that means the hopes I left behind have been impeded—

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) Perhaps I myself have come to an untimely end.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) Dr. {@nickname}...

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) You are surprised by my appearance, Kal'tsit. Have I failed?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) The future of Terra is yet unknown.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) I never expected to see you again, Dr. {@nickname}—

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) This is simply an encrypted program encoded within my cognition model.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) It analyses data input and provides an appropriate response. In other words, it does not possess my emotions or memories.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) I do not wish to disappoint you again, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) ...Why did you leave it behind?

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) Because of you.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) I know that you will only return here when all hope seems lost, in search of one last chance.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) By then, however, I'm afraid that even I am unable to turn things around.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) You cannot help me anymore?

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) My Sarcophagus will render what assistance is possible, to the extent that it is possible for me...

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) Even when It descends upon us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) I didn't come to seek sanctuary, Dr. {@nickname}, but it's true that danger is very near.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) I need your help to take back PRTS.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) That will be difficult.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) The core databank of PRTS will deny access to the individual known as AMa-10. She has set this as an absolute prohibition.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) Is there no way around it?

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) Perhaps there is one.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) If you are no longer AMa-10.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) AMa-10's gemini cycle system has granted you immortality. It appears that the two individuals in the cycle have diverged over the ages.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) Violence and wisdom, conflict and understanding... such evolution represents the most basic power of life.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) But these were duties forced upon you. They have become your shackles.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) Now, I empower you to lay down your duty.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) This is the final gift that I can confer upon you by way of the Sarcophagus, but the ultimate decision is yours.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) What reason is there to hesitate?

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) I must remind you that this is extremely dangerous.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) When you become the interface to PRTS itself, the functions of the Sarcophagus will cause great harm to your physical form.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) The energy supply of the Sarcophagus is insufficient to fulfill your request and protect you at the same time.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) Sanctuary will become torment, and you will forfeit any chance to extend your life. Are you sure you want to do this?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) I am sure.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) I respect your decision.

steps.name: Oracle
steps.text: (Unknown language) Goodbye.

a.text: PRTS permissions updated. Administrator permissions confirmed.
Warning: Repair module has been disabled due to insufficient power.
All communication module channels open. Communications receiver module overclocking procedure completed.
Connecting to local PRTS databank... connection complete.
Warning: Operator vital signs unstable. Unable to load repair module.

steps.text: Kal'tsit feels intense pain.
With her mind connected to the Sarcophagus, vast amounts of data on a civilizational scale begin transmitting with her as the medium.
She sees the main server beneath Laterano...
The silent preservation room...
The Caerula Arbor deep beneath the waves...
The Shadow-Moon rising from the megastructure on the dark side of Terra...
Time and space are compressed into a single web within Kal'tsit's consciousness. She sees all of Terra, and all of Rhodes Island.
She gains a connection to everything.
At the same time, however, the connection between her and Mon3tr, one that has existed for ten thousand years and more, grows weaker by the moment.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Dr.{@nickname}... this duty is not a shackle.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It was always my choice.

a.text: Warning: Operator vital signs unstable. Unable to load repair module.

spans.text: Warning: Operator vital signs unstable. Unable to load repair module.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have no idea what lies ahead, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is the only thing I can do for you before I go to face her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The rest is up to you.
Kal'tsit breaks the limits that her creator placed upon her.
In exchange for half of her life, she is reborn.
Outside the Sarcophagus, Mon3tr roars in anxiety and bewilderment. It has lost track of Kal'tsit for the first time.
The connection between it and Kal'tsit has been completely severed.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am not going to the far side of Terra. She is here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Right here by my side.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I've found you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: My name is Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And what of it—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) Priestess.
Kal'tsit finally speaks her name.

a.text: You are uploading unvalidated data, AMa-10.
But you will not see it through to the end.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Is that so?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm no longer fighting on my own.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I can see you, Raidian.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm fighting for control of PRTS. Time is short.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Trace my signal.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will be your eyes.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Yes, but some compartments are still not responding. They may have taken too much damage.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I've captured the bioelectrical signals of other colleagues. Comparing with environmental data—

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Generating ship-wide scan...

options: Get ready to synchronize all signals, Mantra!

steps.text: You hear Mantra's calm, collected voice in your head.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: All active operators on Rhodes Island have been located. Ready to synchronize data from Raidian at any time.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Scan is complete, Mantra!
'Synchronization complete.'
'Attention all hands, this is Mantra speaking.'
'You are currently seeing in your mind real-time scan data of Rhodes Island's current state.'
'Perhaps you are under attack from unknown sources, or isolated and lost.'
'But we are now taking back the initiative, under the direction of Dr. Kal'tsit.'
'The scale of the current emergency exceeds the scope of individual discretion. You are hereby directed to act in accordance with my instructions.'
'Rendezvous with nearby operators as soon as reasonably possible under your individual circumstances.'
'Regularly monitor the status of your protective equipment and avoid high-threat areas if at all possible.'
'Elite Operators Touch and Pith are conducting cleanup operations outside of the core area. They will be in touch with you to direct regroup efforts.'
'The scale of the task before you must not be underestimated.'
'The Doctor has designated a Conflict Zone, Quarantine Zone, and Buffer Zone, in reverse order of their proximity to the Abyss.'
'While making every effort to ensure your own safety, you are to work on maintaining the Buffer Zone and delaying the expansion of the anomaly.'
'There is reason to believe that this crisis is impacting far more than just Rhodes Island—'

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Cleanup of the two adjacent zones is complete.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: The scattered personnel have regrouped under the direction of Operator Raidian.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: Are you hurt?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: It's not that bad. Closure's protective equipment was more effective than I expected.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: But it's not enough to deal with the dangers of extended exposure to high-Originium environments.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Your squad cannot participate in this next operation. Get some rest in the safe areas of the Buffer Zone once you have received treatment.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: With the witchcraft defenses designed by Logos and Mechanist, you should face much less pressure there.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: This is an order. Don't worry, I won't allow anything to happen to any operator under my charge.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: Once the ship has stopped, you'll need to direct the other squads to evacuate and establish a larger Buffer Zone around the ship.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: Rest and get ready. Leave this to us.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: I hope things go as well on Sharp and Stormeye's side...
'The status of the engines is unclear. There is a risk of collision with objects on the ship's course.'
'We are taking all possible measures to reduce the possibility of this occurring. We will issue the warning to brace for impact, if necessary.'
'The ship will be brought to a stop once we regain control of the engines.'
'Once we do, Rhodes Island will proceed to establish a new Buffer Zone around the ship to prevent further spread of the anomaly.'

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: From this vantage point, it seems the ship is still accelerating.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: Not as much as it had been. What Logos is doing is working.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: Let's trust our comrades. We've got plenty on our plate as it is—evacuating people and eliminating potential threats on the ship's path.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: Brace yourself. We're accelerating.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I have visual on the mobile mining platform. It's possible that the ship will run into it.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Stay on the current course, Stormeye. I'm dropping into the target location in twenty seconds to evacuate the crew of the platform.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: Approaching target.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: See you in a moment.
'The Conflict Zone surrounding the Abyss is the key area that we must break through.'
'The elite operators have conferred and unanimously voted to break into the Abyss together.'
'We are the knife that cuts through the darkness, and we are Rhodes Island's last line of defense.'
'Do not let fear avert your eyes, comrades.'
'Trust in my voice. Trust in Dr. Kal'tsit.'
'Trust in Rhodes Island.'

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Seems like you've eliminated the threat.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: I saw lots of familiar faces before you came.
The floor is littered with broken Originium crystals, a sign of the ferocious battle that just occurred here.
The boiler worker sighs and picks up a broken epaulet made of Originium.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: These Originium things just won't die. I recognize the faces they wear...

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: Some of them I strangled with my own hands, others went away to a far away place. But I don't suppose there are many left of those who left.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: You're not surprised about the things that are happening?

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: There are many secrets on this ship.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: But all I care about is my boilers. That's the one thing I asked Her Highness to let me do.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: I need your help, Aefanyl—

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: I can't get the boilers to cool down, and there wouldn't be anyone here to watch them if I left.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The facilities of the mobility layer are spread out across a large area. Even you can't deal with everything.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: The control system is completely shot. I don't have the tools to manually calibrate the engines.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: Trying to brute force it would be even more dangerous. The Originium particle density in the air is way past the warning line.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: 'Separate.'

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: There is room in the trappings of machinery for words to pass through. I will slow down the supply of fuel to the engine.
He waves his bone pen, and incantations emerge from its tip, passing through the steel walls and expanding outwards.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: 'Stay.'

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I shall embrace Rhodes Island with words.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I will pull it back.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: The ship is slowing down.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: None of us is giving up, Chloe.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Our efforts are not futile. We will not allow them to be futile.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I guarantee that they will receive your gift...

steps.name: Trapped Originium Entity
steps.text: (Struggles)

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You'll be free soon. The latest data have been uploaded to Kal'tsit. Once it's validated—
The Originium entity shatters silently, every last fragment removed from the lab through the ventilation system.
This strange thing will trouble Warfarin no more.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: ...Success.
But she finds little joy in it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The ship is slowing down. Logos has been successful.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: About the course that Logos brought up... Dr. Kal'tsit has charted three possible courses.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There is one thing in common among all three predictions.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They all end in the Targangils Prime Vein. I believe that is the course that PRTS has set.

options: This ship is being guided towards the vein?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: However, the predicted course that best matches the current course will take us through a major canyon.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's unlikely that we'll be able to traverse it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Definitely strange. All the threats that we're dealing with right now don't seem bent on completely destroying Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Losing PRTS, the appearance of the Originium entities, the shifts in the ship's internals, the change of course... none of these things would truly destroy us.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I have a breakthrough regarding the Originium monsters, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: After uploading the experiment data to Kal'tsit, she has modified the bottom-level logic of Originium Arc and distributed the upgrade package to all operators.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: It will allow them to more effectively deal with these Originium entities.

options: Where did your data come from?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Let's have a long chat, you and I and Kal'tsit, after we get out of this mess.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: That's all I have to say.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: ...I still have patients to attend to.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Warfarin...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Whatever the case, Dr. Warfarin and Kal'tsit have taken care of a big problem for us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But all these threats only serve to delay our solution to the problem.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is it possible that the one we're facing doesn't want to be our enemy, Dr. {@nickname}?

options: More likely, they just have no choice.
We'll know what's going on once we're in the Abyss.
Give me a location on Closure, Raidian.
Pass the word on to Closure, Mantra.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: You got it, Doctor.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I've located her signal. Communicating with Mantra.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: One moment.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I'm getting the location from Raidian right now.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Ready.

options: How are things going on your side, Closure?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We analyzed the structural changes recorded by Raidian, and it seems like the shifts correspond to certain cyclical patterns.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It's just that the data sample from each individual cycle is so vast and disorganized that we thought the changes occurred at random.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It's all thanks to Mechanist that we managed to figure it out.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Wasn't so complicated after all, once you had data of sufficient quantity and accuracy.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Also, Closure and I have created a provisional model that we can use to calculate and plan a route.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: In other words, the spatial shifting won't trouble us for a while.

options: There's no time to waste then.
We'll attempt to penetrate the Abyss.
Before that, we must assemble and provide support to Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: These damn things just won't stop coming—

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: You're too slow.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Now's the time for you to get out.
Misery shakes his head.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: We don't have nearly enough intel.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: This is the closest place to the Abyss that we've reached. We're the only people who've gotten this far, and the only ones who can help Raidian locate it—

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: That's not what you're really thinking about.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: I don't want to be too slow again.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Isn't that the same for you, Ascalon?

steps.name: Mantra's Voice
steps.text: Rosmontis and Blaze's squad is approaching your location, but they've run into a small problem.

steps.name: Mantra's Voice
steps.text: They've been delayed.
Blaze scratches her head and looks at Rosmontis helplessly.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: How do we handle this, kitten?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I... I'm not sure.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: The buggies are still preparing to attack us.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I don't want to harm them.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Why did they suddenly lose control when we approached this area—

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wait, Friston-3! Stop!

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: No, I'm not going to ram you or breathe fire at you like the kids. I'm perfectly normal.

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: Now, let me through. Time is short, and my patience even shorter.
